Subject: Reminder: Punctuality for Client Meetings

Hi [Employee Name],

I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. It is crucial that we arrive on time, as punctuality is a key reflection of our company’s professionalism and respect for our clients.

I have noticed a few instances of tardiness recently, and I want to ensure we get this back on track. Please make sure to plan your schedule to allow for a buffer so you can arrive promptly.

If you are facing any challenges that might affect your ability to be on time, please let me know so we can discuss solutions.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
